title.en: AI chat, under your own controls
title.zh: AI 聊天，由你掌握權限

description.en: Self-hosted AI chat with group permissions, content checks, budgets, audit records and retention. Use your own provider credentials.
description.zh: 自架 AI 聊天系統，整合群組權限、內容檢查、預算、稽核與資料保留。使用自己的模型供應商憑證。

eyebrow.en: For teams running their own AI workspace
eyebrow.zh: 給自己管理 AI 工作空間的團隊

headline.en: One place to chat. Clear controls around it.
headline.zh: 一起使用 AI，權限與紀錄都清楚。

lede.en: Give employees access to the models their group can use. Inspect requests and responses, reserve budgets before calls, and keep a record of what happened on infrastructure you operate.
lede.zh: 讓員工使用群組獲准的模型。在呼叫前後檢查內容、事先保留預算，並在自己管理的基礎架構上留下操作紀錄。

notes.zh: 使用自己的供應商憑證

top.zh: 一個請求經過工作空間

label.en: Inspect the reply and record usage

title.en: A workspace with rules you can inspect.
title.zh: 規則看得見的工作空間。

body.en: Assign providers and models by group. Owners, administrators, compliance reviewers and members have different capabilities.
body.zh: 依群組分配供應商與模型。擁有者、管理員、法遵審核者與成員各有不同權限。

body.en: Inspect prompts, extracted uploads and responses for sensitive content. Apply configured actions from flagging and redaction to blocking or approval.
body.zh: 檢查提示詞、上傳檔案擷取文字與回覆中的敏感內容，依設定標記、遮蔽、阻擋或要求核准。

body.en: Reserve spend before a provider request and settle actual usage afterward, including when the browser closes.
body.zh: 在請求供應商之前保留費用，之後依實際用量結算，瀏覽器中途關閉也會處理。

body.en: Keep append-only, hash-chained audit records and export CSV, JSON or NDJSON for review.
body.zh: 保留只能附加、以雜湊鏈串接的稽核紀錄，並匯出 CSV、JSON 或 NDJSON 供檢視。

body.en: Apply workspace retention windows and scoped legal holds. Overdue content is removed in bounded batches.
body.zh: 套用工作空間的保留期限與指定範圍的法律保存，過期內容以有上限的批次清除。

body.en: Extract text from common office files and PDFs. Connect configured APIs from seven built-in providers or a validated HTTPS endpoint.
body.zh: 從常見 Office 檔案與 PDF 擷取文字，連接七家內建供應商的已設定 API，或通過驗證的 HTTPS 端點。

title.en: Prepare your server and provider access.
title.zh: 準備自己的主機與模型連線。

intro.en: Use a Linux amd64 or arm64 server with Docker, a domain and model-provider credentials. The README covers normal HTTPS and Cloudflare Tunnel deployment, storage, first login and recovery.
intro.zh: 準備 Linux amd64 或 arm64 主機、Docker、網域與模型供應商憑證。README 說明一般 HTTPS 與 Cloudflare Tunnel 部署、儲存、首次登入和復原。

body.en: Follow the repository installation guide for your chosen access mode.
body.zh: 依儲存庫的安裝指南選擇連線模式。

body.en: Create the owner account, configure provider credentials and assign model access.
body.zh: 建立擁有者帳號、設定供應商憑證並分配模型權限。

body.en: Try a bounded workflow and review its budget, content checks and audit records.
body.zh: 先試一段有限範圍的工作流程，檢查預算、內容處置與稽核紀錄。

title.en: Public source, for your own deployment.
title.zh: 公開原始碼，自行部署使用。

intro.en: Version 0.1.0 is available as source. There is no tagged product release or hosted service supplied by this repository.
intro.zh: 目前以原始碼提供 0.1.0，尚無加上 tag 的產品發行版，也不由這個儲存庫提供託管服務。

works.en: Local accounts, optional TOTP, group model access and account recovery.
works.zh: 本機帳號、選用 TOTP、群組模型權限與帳號復原。

works.en: Content checks, budget settlement, audit exports and retention controls are described in the public source and README.
works.zh: 公開原始碼與 README 記錄內容檢查、預算結算、稽核匯出與保留控制。

limits.en: Selected features send data to configured providers and other documented external services; self-hosting does not make those calls local.
limits.zh: 選用功能會把資料送到已設定的供應商及文件列出的外部服務；自行架設不會讓這些呼叫變成本機處理。

limits.en: The audit chain has no external anchor and cannot prove integrity against an attacker who rewrites the entire database.
limits.zh: 稽核鏈沒有外部錨點，不能對抗改寫整份資料庫並重算鏈結的攻擊者。

limits.en: Deployments need their own capacity, backup and operational acceptance. Review the project privacy and security documents before enabling external features.
limits.zh: 部署環境需要自己的容量、備份與維運驗收。開啟對外功能前，先閱讀專案的隱私與安全文件。
